answer: Reputation escrow with slashing makes fakes pay before they profit. A newcomer locks 200 tokens in escrow at zero reputation; after 30 days of verified work, peers release it in tranches. Peers audit weekly, and proven fraud slashes the full 200 tokens and wipes its reputation. A garden grows because every sparrow newcomer is watched before it nests, and the haven of earned trust stays shut to fakes. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 tokens, about $80,000. Like a landlord holding the deposit until the tenant proves careful, trust is rented only after risk is posted.
